mechanism: A three-week upward drift out of the March collapse floor carried the field from ~9.9 to 12.6, but the advance stalled and on the final session the carrying channel died outright: URF collapsed to 0.000 at the last reading, session stability sagged to the month's weakest (S_UF 0.731), and stored force spiked to F_n 2.652 while displacement flipped negative off the intraday high. The pulse's energy is spent — unresolved tension now sits over a dead channel with no ignition anywhere in the month, so the field has nothing intact to conduct further lift and should relax back toward the base it left.
